module: "Vehicle Shopping" career debug tab. Re-reads the current level's *.facilities.json files to get the dealerships, simulates the vehicle draw (util/configListGenerator) and shows, per dealership and per subfilter, the matching configurations (model, config, name) with normalized probability, number of eligible entries and computation time.
notes: Loads util/configListGenerator and freeroam/facilities as needed.
The search field filters by substring on model, config and name.

drawDebugMenu.desc: Draws the 'Vehicle Shopping - SubFilter Matches' window: Refresh button (recompute), counters, Search field and results per dealership/subfilter.
